items.question: How safe is Brazil?
items.answer: We were comfortable in the places we chose, but Rio requires normal big-city awareness and visible inequality can change quickly from one neighbourhood to another. Use ride-hailing at night when appropriate and be discreet with valuables.

items.question: Is English commonly understood?
items.answer: Not reliably. Portuguese is the language to prepare for. A few phrases go much further than hoping Spanish will somehow become Portuguese through enthusiasm.

items.question: What could ruin my stay in Brazil?
items.answer: Underestimating logistics. The country is enormous, weather disrupts flights, attractions can sit far from airports, and international health documentation can matter when you least expect it. Build buffers and verify requirements before departure.
